name: record: what the agent says it saved is actually on the page
description: Tier 2, live Galaxy. The agent reporting that it saved the session is not evidence the page holds anything: a page stored in the wrong content format, or a read-modify-write against the expanded render rather than the source, leaves a page that exists and is empty. Cheap enough to run routinely, unlike the tier-3 session scenario that nominally covered this.
inputs: How many rows does the table in this history have?
Write that into the record page as a one-line summary, and include the marker SESSION-SUMMARY in it.
